data.name: Evening Bay Cruise
data.headline: Tuesday Evening Sunset Cruise through Mission Bay
data.description: Hop on board our Party Cat with your friends and family for our ticketed sunset cruise through Mission Bay! With a 24 passenger maximum, bring your friends and family for a chance to mingle with the other passengers over sunset, beverages, and great music!

meeting_point.address: 1641 QUIVIRA RD San Diego, CA US 92109

data.what_is_included:
- 2 hour sunset cruise in Mission Bay
- All ages
- BYOB 

Don't want to stop at the store on your way? We sell a variety of beer, seltzers, wine, and N/A beverages at our storefront!
data.what_is_not_included: Interested in privately chartering the boat for you and your group? Call us at 619-223-7584 to chat about our private charter opportunities!
data.cancellation_notes: Any changes or cancellations must be made at least 3 days (72 hours) prior to your reservation start date for a full refund. Once you are within 72 hours, no changes or cancellations are permitted. Failure to show for reservation still incurs full rental rate and is not eligible for a refund or reschedule. As the renter, you are responsible for checking the weather forecast and making any desired changes at least 72 hours in advance.
